variants.label: Slate blue + graphite
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit (logo-brand recolor)
Asset type: transparent color variant of the approved Catnap logo.
Input image: the supplied original logo is the EDIT TARGET.
Primary request: recolor ONLY the two parts of this exact existing logo into the "Slate blue + graphite" colorway.
Exact color mapping: all existing filled pixels of the curled sleeping cat symbol become solid #557C9A. All existing filled pixels of the lowercase "catnap" wordmark become solid #3D4855.
Invariants: preserve the original logo's exact silhouette and geometry, cat ears, closed eye, nose, curl, tail, transparent cutouts, all six letter shapes, kerning, proportions, relative sizes, and horizontal composition. Do not redesign or reinterpret. Change colors only.
Text verbatim: "catnap", using the existing original lettering, not retyped lettering.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, with every original negative-space cutout still transparent. No white fill in the eye, face or tail cutouts. Preserve the transparent canvas.
Rendering: clean flat solid colors with crisp edges. No gradients, shading, shadows, texture, outlines, background rectangle, mockup, labels, extra text, or added decoration. One logo only.
Intended use: light backgrounds.

variants.label: Ice blue + white
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit (logo-brand recolor)
Asset type: clean Catnap logo colorway for dark backgrounds.
The supplied original black transparent logo is the edit target. Preserve its exact cat silhouette, curled tail, ears, closed eye and nose, all six lowercase letter shapes and spacing, and the horizontal composition.
Change ONLY color and backdrop: place the original shape on a perfectly flat solid deep navy background #172B40. Recolor only the cat silhouette to #9AC7E2; recolor only the "catnap" lettering to #FFFFFF.
CRITICAL: Every negative-space cutout in the original cat and letters must be entirely navy, the exact same #172B40 as the background. Preserve clean, open cutouts for the closed-eye stroke, nose, space between the cat's body and curled tail, and the centers of the letters a and p. Keep all spaces between letters navy. The negative space is NOT white.
This is finished precision logo artwork: flat uniform colors, perfectly crisp smooth antialiased vector-like edges, no fuzzy halos, no speckles, no rough paint, no texture, no gradients, no shadows, no thin outlines, no extra marks.
Background is fully opaque, one perfectly uniform flat #172B40. There is NO transparency in this version. Single logo, exact original horizontal layout, generous outer padding. No labels or extra words.
